text: Heb. iustice. , Heb. without lips of deceit.
Or, that sauest them which trust in thee from these that rise vp against thy right hand.
Heb. that waste me. , Heb. my enemies against the soule.
Heb. the likeness of him (i. of euery one of them) is as a lion that desireth to rauin. , Heb. sitting.
Heb. preuent his face. , Or, by thy sword.
Or, from by thine hand. , Or, their children are full.
